generation.scope: An integral opposite octic with curve kernel image always normalizes to a single-line scroll over the normalized kernel curve, including nonreduced windows. Cokernel duality excludes conic fibers, and opposite quadratic interpolation excludes paired skew rulings. The conductor quotient has Hilbert polynomial (degree-genus-3)(t+1); in equality with reduced window and finite rank-one locus, the 20-4g triple-ruling formula forces a twisted cubic.

open_mathematics: Use the scroll cokernel and its exceptional ruling lines on rational defective or singular kernel curves, and analyze surface kernel images and exceptional finite middles.
